intent: I found Dad’s old brass fishing lure in his coat and kept it because I need to believe he carried one memory home with him. During the fight he broke the skin on my forearm. I cleaned it, but I have told neither Mike nor CatEye81, and every pause in my own speech now frightens me. The room becoming quiet brought relief before grief, and I hate myself for that. I reserve one cartridge and promise not to let guilt make the next decision.
emotion: grieving, ashamed, exhausted, frightened by possible exposure, and quietly resolving to survive
